name: world-time-mcp
description: Time and calendar answers agents get wrong: the time anywhere by city, country or zone, DST-safe conversions that flag skipped and repeated hours, public holidays for 200+ countries and their regions, business-day arithmetic with each country's own weekend, and meeting slots across time zones. Works offline, no key.

dependencyReasons.date-holidays: Holiday rules for 207 countries and their states and regions, with substitute days and lunar calendars; no keyless API covers that breadth, and rules answer any year offline in milliseconds.
dependencyReasons.city-timezones: 7,300 cities with population, country, province and IANA zone, so agents can name a city instead of a zone; no network call, no dependencies of its own.
